explanation: Silkworms are caterpillars of the domesticated silk moth, bred for so long that the adults can no longer fly. Each cocoon unwinds as a single, continuous thread.

claims.text: Silk for cloth comes from the cocoons of silkworms, the caterpillars of the domesticated silk moth, and of a few wild silk moths.
Silk cloth is not made from the cocoons of butterfly caterpillars, beetle grubs or wasp larvae.
Adult domesticated silk moths cannot fly.
A silkworm cocoon is spun from a single continuous thread of silk.
